title: Block manifest: the single source of truth for one library block

block_file.description: Path of the app block, relative to the library root

licence.description: Must be true for every proprietary block

slots.description: Places where brand copy or images go. The installer fills these from the brand config and copy file.

suggested_fact_keys.description: Hints for brand-config `facts` keys. Never a source of copy by itself.

min_filled_slots.description: The block is only added when at least this many required slots have copy

settings.description: Block-specific settings. When present the block file is GENERATED by tools/build_blocks.py (with src/<id>.liquid and src/<id>.css).

standard_controls.description: Standard controls added to every generated block

script.description: The block has src/<id>.js, copied to assets/dtj-<id>.js and loaded through the schema's javascript key

css_includes.description: Shared css fragments src/_<name>.css added to the generated stylesheet

standard_defaults.description: Per-block defaults for standard controls, for example text_size or padding_top

sample.description: Settings that make the block render

expect.description: Strings that must appear when licensed and filled

data_needs.description: Metafields or other data the block reads
